name: suits_grok-imagine-image
prompt: Night, the shoulder of a dark lakefront highway. Low camera at road level. In the background a black sedan is parked with its two headlights blazing straight into the lens, flooding the scene with hard white backlight and long shadows on the asphalt. Four tall men in identical dark suits walk toward the camera in a tight V formation, seen only as pitch-black backlit silhouettes, faces completely in shadow and unreadable, only the outline of sunglasses, shoulders, ties and swinging arms. Faint red and blue glow at the edges. Cinematic night photograph, 16:9 wide frame, high contrast, deep black shadows, hard directional light, clean readable geometry, strong silhouettes, minimal clutter, sharp focus, anamorphic film still. No text, no signs, no lettering, no logos, no license plates.
